description: This file defines constants, types, and function prototypes for parsing and handling NMEA GPS messages such as GPRMC and GPGGA. It provides structures for storing GPS location data and functions for message type identification, checksum validation, and parsing of message contents.

methods.name: nmea_get_message_type
methods.description: Determines the message type of a given NMEA sentence.

methods.name: nmea_valid_checksum
methods.description: Validates the checksum of an NMEA message.

methods.name: nmea_parse_gpgga
methods.description: Parses a GPGGA NMEA message and populates a GPS location structure.

methods.name: nmea_parse_gprmc
methods.description: Parses a GPRMC NMEA message and populates a GPS location structure.

methods.name: gps_location
methods.description: Populates a GPS location structure based on the given data and message.
